split_strategy: Manual. The hardest cases are the sibling-skill deferrals (N1 MCP-server listing → find-mcp-directories, N2 general non-AI SaaS launch → find-product-directories) and the 'find a directory vs hire a firm / compare products / DIY' confusions (N3 hiring an AI consultancy, N4 product comparison). Those go in train. Validation tests generalization across remaining AI-listing phrasings (agent skills, GPT apps) and out-of-scope shapes.
passing_rule: should_trigger=true → trigger_rate > 0.5 over 3 runs. should_trigger=false → trigger_rate ≤ 0.5.
